title: Photo bleed, looping
headline: D with a looping, bigger animation
lede: Option D with your three changes. Open the live page to see the animation loop.
summary: The Replay button is gone and the animation loops on its own: it holds the DIVI screen, fades out and starts again. “Text us to split your bill” is sage green like C. The animation rises into the faded part of the photo, now 10% smaller than before on phones and 20% smaller on laptops. Everything fits on one screen.
